# Workflow Requirements Checklist: Hello World Message Delivery

**Purpose**: Validate requirement quality for manual greeting workflow behavior, reliability, and operational expectations.
**Created**: 2026-10-18
**Feature**: [Link to spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 Are trigger preconditions and "normal access" eligibility criteria for intended users explicitly defined? [Completeness, Spec §FR-001, Spec §FR-006]
- [ ] CHK002 Are the required user-facing error message contents defined for unavailable/malformed triggers and retry exhaustion paths? [Gap, Spec §FR-004, Spec §FR-005]
- [ ] CHK003 Does the specification define what qualifies as a valid greeting request beyond malformed or unavailable trigger conditions? [Clarity, Spec §FR-002, Spec §Edge Cases]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK004 Is "clear, user-friendly error message" quantified with specific wording or quality criteria? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-004]
- [ ] CHK005 Is "temporary service issue" scoped with concrete failure conditions that activate retry behavior? [Clarity, Spec §FR-005]
- [ ] CHK006 Is "without requiring additional setup beyond normal access" defined with objective reviewer-verifiable criteria? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-006]

## Requirement Consistency

- [ ] CHK007 Do all artifacts use one canonical greeting string without punctuation/casing conflicts? [Conflict, Spec §FR-002, Plan §Summary]
- [ ] CHK008 Are retry totals and limits consistent between functional requirements and edge-case narrative (initial + 3 retries = 4 attempts)? [Consistency, Spec §FR-005, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK009 Do manual trigger requirements align across clarifications and contract language for invocation mode and constraints? [Consistency, Spec §Clarifications, Contract §Interface 1]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [ ] CHK010 Can SC-002 latency targets be measured with a defined sampling window and metric source? [Measurability, Spec §SC-002]
- [ ] CHK011 Is SC-003 "sampled users" defined with sample-size and sampling-method requirements? [Gap, Spec §SC-003]
- [ ] CHK012 Is "unresolved error" in SC-004 explicitly defined with counting rules and exclusions? [Ambiguity, Spec §SC-004]

## Scenario Coverage

- [ ] CHK013 Are primary-flow requirements complete from manual trigger initiation through user-visible greeting delivery? [Coverage, Spec §User Story 1, Spec §FR-001]
- [ ] CHK014 Are alternate-flow requirements defined for repeated rapid requests, including ordering or idempotency expectations? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK015 Are exception-flow requirements defined for invalid payload, authorization failure, and trigger unavailability outcomes? [Coverage, Gap, Contract §Error Contract]
- [ ] CHK016 Are recovery-flow requirements specified for in-progress retries and terminal failure communication to users? [Coverage, Recovery, Spec §FR-005]

## Edge Case Coverage

- [ ] CHK017 Are boundary requirements defined for concurrent or duplicate manual requests and unique execution naming behavior? [Edge Case, Contract §Request Rules]
- [ ] CHK018 Are malformed JSON input boundaries specified beyond the supported empty-object input case? [Edge Case, Contract §Request Rules]
- [ ] CHK019 Are requirements defined for partial observability failures (for example, success occurs but log visibility is delayed)? [Gap, Edge Case]

## Non-Functional Requirements

- [ ] CHK020 Are observability requirements specified beyond log content, including actionable failure signals and retention expectations? [Gap, Constitution §V, Spec §SC-004]
- [ ] CHK021 Are authorization and access-control requirements documented for triggering executions and reading logs? [Gap, Constitution §II, Contract §Interface 1]
- [ ] CHK022 Are explicit non-goals for localization/personalization framed as measurable scope constraints? [Completeness, Spec §Assumptions]

## Dependencies & Assumptions

- [ ] CHK023 Are dependency assumptions (Step Functions and CloudWatch availability/permissions) documented with ownership and validation expectations? [Dependency, Assumption, Spec §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK024 Is a traceability scheme defined that links FR/SC requirements to contract clauses for review? [Traceability, Gap]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit-specify` and `/speckit-clarify`
- Add comments or findings inline
- Link to relevant resources or documentation
- Items are numbered sequentially for easy reference
